__name: Other mods of the author on the title screen (UITitleScreenEvent, panel "More mods by Fouru")
__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod.
Enabled: the panel is shown. RotateSec: seconds a mod stays before the next one (several mods, at least 3).

Mods, in this order: ModId (not shown when that mod is loaded: the player has it; empty: always shown), Name, Text and Button (a localText key of Taoist or the text itself), Image (a 16:9 picture in ModImg of Taoist), Url (opened by the button).
